rationale: Capture continuation when each market has positive own-trend signal.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Long when close > EMA100 and 20-bar return > 0; exit when close < EMA50 or ATR stop/time stop.
overfitting_risk: Medium if EMA/return windows are tuned.
expected_failure_mode: Long-only beta and late trend entries underperform no-trade or passive BTC.

rationale: Allocate to strongest markets rather than every long signal.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: At weekly rebalance, rank 30-day return; hold top 3 positive-return markets with fixed risk until rank exits top half or stop.
primary_risk: Concentration in high-beta alts and crash beta.
overfitting_risk: High if rank count or lookback tuned.
expected_failure_mode: Winners reverse, BTC weak, or gains isolated to one outlier.

rationale: Test clean price-channel breakout independent of failed Long1 logic.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Long close above prior 55-bar high; stop at prior 20-bar low or 2*ATR; exit close below 20-bar low.
primary_risk: Late breakout chasing and false breakouts.
expected_failure_mode: Looks like trend following and fails BTC/no-trade gates.

source_reference_type: Bollinger squeeze / volatility compression public references
rationale: Enter only after compressed volatility expands, not during ordinary late trend.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Require BB width in lowest 20% of trailing 120 bars, then long close above upper band with volume > 20-bar median; ATR stop; exit middle band/time stop.
primary_risk: False squeeze breakouts and volume noise.
overfitting_risk: High if compression percentile, lookback, and volume trigger tuned.
expected_failure_mode: Too few trades or breakout failure in alts.

rationale: Simple oversold reversion family distinct from trend continuation, but must not revive Candidate D.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Long close below lower BB20/2 and RSI14 < 30; exit SMA20 touch, stop 1*ATR below entry candle low, max 8 bars.
overfitting_risk: High due prior Candidate D failure and threshold temptation.

rationale: Test time-of-day or recent-intraday continuation/reversal effects.
required_data: 1h or lower OHLCV preferred; 4h may be too coarse
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Plan-only until 1h/15m market-wide data exists; candidate would compare first-half-day move to later reversal/continuation.
primary_risk: Requires finer data and higher turnover costs.

rationale: Use funding as cost/sentiment/carry context rather than pure OHLCV.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Plan candidate separate from failed gate: market-neutral carry if spot/perp hedge data exists, otherwise funding context filter only.
primary_risk: Funding edge erased by price moves, fees, borrowing, and basis risk.
overfitting_risk: High if thresholds tuned after failed funding gate.
expected_failure_mode: Like funding gate: reduces losses but no positive edge.

rationale: Market-neutral carry/basis family may be genuinely different from directional OHLCV paths.
required_data: spot prices, perp prices, funding, borrow/fee assumptions, execution spread
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Plan-only cash-and-carry/basis monitor: long spot, short perp when annualized basis/funding exceeds fixed hurdle with strict unwind rules.
overfitting_risk: Medium if hurdle tuned; operational assumptions dominate.
expected_failure_mode: Data unavailable or net carry after frictions <= no-trade.

rationale: Permit trend entries only during predeclared market regime.
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Long trend candidate only when BTC close > BTC EMA200 and BTC realized volatility below trailing 75th percentile; entry via EMA50/EMA100 trend.
primary_risk: Prior regime-filtered long-only already failed; filter can remove winners.
expected_failure_mode: BTC boundary failure or no-trade not beaten.

rationale: Test relative-value behavior with reduced market beta.
required_data: OHLCV plus short/perp availability and borrow/funding assumptions
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Plan-only or constrained: pick predeclared BTC/ETH, SOL/ETH, LINK/ETH pairs using formation window only; trade z-score spread with fixed stop.
primary_risk: Cointegration breaks, shorting costs, liquidity mismatch.
overfitting_risk: Very high if pair selection done after results.
expected_failure_mode: Pair selection/cherry-picking or inability to execute shorts.

rationale: Study range/volatility harvesting with strict loss caps, not live grid deployment.
required_data: 4h OHLCV minimum; lower timeframe preferable for grid realism
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Simulated capped range strategy: only one market-independent synthetic grid per market, no leverage, hard stop if range breaks by 1 ATR.
primary_risk: Inventory accumulation, range breakout, fees, hidden leverage.
overfitting_risk: Very high if range/grid spacing tuned.
expected_failure_mode: Fee drag or severe loss on range break.

rationale: Compare simple supervised baseline against rule candidates, not black-box edge claims.
required_data: features from OHLCV plus strict walk-forward labels
representative_frozen_candidate_concept: Logistic regression only, fixed features, walk-forward train/test; trade only if probability exceeds predeclared confidence and beats naive baseline.
overfitting_risk: Very high without locked feature set and nested validation.
expected_failure_mode: Accuracy does not translate to net PnL after fees or simple baseline dominates.
